scientific_integrity: A complete all-n proof is supplied from two simplicial good covers. Finite enumeration and mod-two ranks only corroborate its premises; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: n>=3 crown graphs only; second independence/devoid complex only. Integral natural symmetry action is proved, but no equivariant simple-homotopy collapse or extension to other graph products is claimed. Independent mathematical audit and absolute novelty priority are outstanding.
title: Crown-graph dissociation complexes: sphere wedges and an integral symmetry lattice
